_comment: Shared listing copy for every directory. Keep in sync with server.json and the Apify Store page.
name: Podcast Transcript API
tagline: Podcast transcripts from RSS, Apple Podcasts or audio URLs: publisher transcript or Whisper STT.
description: Podcast transcripts from RSS feeds, Apple Podcasts links, episode pages or audio URLs. Uses the publisher's own transcript for a flat $0.01 when one exists, Whisper large-v3 otherwise ($0.009/min). Budget checked before each episode, so it never overspends. Text, segments, SRT, VTT, MD.
whenToChoose: You want the cheapest correct transcript: the publisher's own transcript (Podcasting 2.0 <podcast:transcript>, SRT/VTT/JSON/HTML) is used first at a flat $0.01 per episode; speech-to-text runs only when none exists.
You have mixed inputs: RSS feeds, Apple Podcasts show and episode (?i=) links, episode pages (feed found automatically) and direct mp3/m4a/video URLs in one call.
You need agent-ready output: text, llmText, timestamped segments, SRT, VTT, Markdown plus a combined TRANSCRIPTS.md, chapters and speaker labels.
You need to monitor shows: onlyNewEpisodes with a monitorId returns only episodes published since the last run (cloud-tested 20 Oct 2026: second run returned 0 episodes, $0).

You need hard cost control: maxTotalChargeUsd, maxAudioMinutes and maxMinutesPerEpisode (skip or truncate) stop before spending; over-budget, unreachable, no-speech and invalid inputs come back as free rows with errorType, retryable and hint.

Accuracy check (20 Oct 2026, against publisher transcripts): English word error rate about 2-3%, Spanish about 10%, German about 17%; long episodes are cut at pauses into ~2-minute chunks so no sentences are dropped.
Head-to-head (our test, Apify cloud, 20 Oct 2026, identical inputs against 4 podcast transcript Actors in the Store): 10/10 checks; the others scored 2-6/10.
comparison: Per their Apify Store pages on 20 Oct 2026: steadyfetch/media-transcriber charges $0.006 per audio minute and always transcribes, even when the show publishes a free transcript; spokentext/spotify-podcast-transcript charges $0.003 per minute. This tool charges $0.01 per episode when a publisher transcript exists and $0.009-0.006 per minute otherwise.
chooseAnotherToolWhen: You need Spotify-exclusive episodes, the lowest possible per-minute speech-to-text price (some Store Actors charge $0.003-0.006/min), or speaker diarization of speech-to-text audio (speaker labels come only from publisher transcripts).
auth: OAuth (sign in with Apify) or header Authorization: Bearer <APIFY_TOKEN>
